name: Martin U. Fuentes
office: City of Cudahy, Member of the City Council

items.text: Martin U. Fuentes is a member of the Cudahy City Council, elected in 2022. He previously worked as a field deputy for Congresswoman Lucille Roybal-Allard on school overcrowding, construction and park space, and for State Senator Gloria Romero on legislation protecting workers' wages. He was also political director for SEIU Local 1877, supporting the Justice for Janitors campaigns.

sentences.text: Martin U. Fuentes is a member of the Cudahy City Council, elected in 2022.

He previously worked as a field deputy for Congresswoman Lucille Roybal-Allard on school overcrowding, construction and park space, and for State Senator Gloria Romero on legislation protecting workers' wages.
He was also political director for SEIU Local 1877, supporting the Justice for Janitors campaigns.

items.text: His campaign announcement says he advocates for a more walkable community and would continue to pursue funding for the Lugo Teen Center renovation. In March 2026, the city council voted 4-0 to censure him after an independent investigation found two of three misconduct allegations credible. He was barred from holding individual meetings with most city employees and required to complete conduct training.
